regions.merged_text: My Dear Confrater Simon: More than simpley to say "A thousand times many thanks" for your practical/in the elaborate preparations and actual celebration of the golden jubilee at dear Saint Bonaventure's a few weeks back (Jan.26); I want to congratulate you and your dear Tertiaries - every Juniors ofcourse as will as the Seniors-and I am inclined to say especially the members of the privileged Eucharistic Mission Band, on their beautiful, artistic, generosity. One could hardly feel other than convinced without a second thought that they must all have worked in real Franciscan harmony together in "so masterly putting over" such a fraternally loyal display. May our dear Lord bless all and each who helped along. I am sure that, even aside from the solem holy Mass itself - whose very ceremonies, etc, I am assured brought tears to many a noncatholic eye - that the mutually fraternal simplicity of the whole proposition was a source of much happy edification. Writing later on when the tention of excitement had gone (if there had been such), a certain Jew who attended and understood the beautiful prayers with the epistle and Gosle, etc, assured me that he could not restrain his tears.
